title: Potato Measurement Physics — Seeing Composition, Water, Structure and State Without Destroying the Tuber
purpose: Define how the physical and chemical state of a potato can actually be measured: spectroscopy, dielectric response, magnetic resonance, imaging, calorimetry, rheology and transport measurements.
measurement_principle: A scientific potato model should connect hidden state variables to observables. Different instruments sense different physics; no single measurement is 'the truth of the potato'.

limits: indirect inference rather than direct molecule counting

modalities.physics: frequency-dependent polarization and conduction of water, ions and membranes
limits: strong sensitivity to heterogeneity, geometry, temperature, water and ionic composition

modalities.physics: frequency-dependent resistance/capacitance of extracellular fluid, membranes and intracellular compartments
nuclear spin relaxation and diffusion of water in magnetic fields
strengths: sensitive to water mobility and compartmentation
limits: cost, acquisition complexity, interpretation depends on structure and starch/water state
small destructive sample; thermal history and water content matter

modalities.physics: coherent scattering from ordered molecular structure
birefringence of ordered anisotropic starch granules
strengths: simple visual marker of granule order

limits: complex spectra and calibration; penetration varies

modalities.physics: stress–strain, fracture and oscillatory viscoelastic response
strengths: connects cell/tissue structure to material behavior
limits: geometry and loading-rate dependent; often destructive
indirect and affected by internal composition/air space

observability_map: genotype is not directly visible from texture
dry matter can be estimated by density, NIR, HSI or dielectric response
water state can be probed by MRI/NMR rather than bulk moisture alone
membrane integrity can be probed by impedance and electroporation response
starch order can be probed by XRD, polarized optics and DSC
mechanical phenotype can be probed from single-cell to whole-tissue scales

project_use.core_rule: For every physical Potato claim, ask: what variable, what unit, what sensor, what timescale, what perturbation, what falsifier?
project_use.spudlight: If the project discusses light interacting with potato tissue, use real optical observables—absorption, scattering, reflectance, fluorescence or photosynthetic response—before symbolic interpretation.
project_use.starchforce: If the project discusses stored capacity, measurable neighbors are chemical free energy, starch mass, enthalpy, redox/metabolic flux and mechanical/osmotic state; do not label them a fifth fundamental force.
